The '''Sith Empire''', named the '''Kingdom of the Sith''' in rumors abroad, was an ancient [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] ruled by the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] [[Pre-Republic era|before]] the [[25,053 BBY|advent]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. 

Created circa [[28,000 BBY]] when [[Adas]] unified the many scattered Sith nations and [[Circle (Sith Pureblood)|tribes]] on Korriban and established himself as the soveign of Korriban. [[27,700 BBY|Three hundred]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, King Adas died following the defeat of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] invaders. 

After the king's death, the Sith Empire was torn apart in the ensuing power struggle as many warlords claimed kingship for themselves. [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]] temporarily [[Korriban civil war (Dathka Graush)|unified]] his people for [[Graush dynasty|his fifty year reign]], but was assassinated by his own council.

The Sith Empire was reunified for a short time at some point before [[6900 BBY]], with the rise of King [[Hakagram Graush]]&mdash;who was deemed a proper successor. Soon after that however, [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]] arrived and seized power on Korriban. They then took the name Sith for their own and became a [[Sith/Legends|sect]] of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who utilized the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], leading their own version of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].

==History==
Prior to [[28,000 BBY]] the Sith culture was one of primitive tribal fighting. One Sith, born with prophesied black pigmented skin, sought to unite the people of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] into an Empire, and succeeded by setting himself up as the first monarch of the Sith people. Having united all of Korriban under one rule, [[Sith King]] [[Adas]] was given the title of [[Sith'ari/Legends|Sith'ari]], or Lord of the Sith.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

King Adas' rule lasted 300 years until in [[27,700 BBY]], when, while [[Invasion of Korriban|fighting off]] the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] invaders, he lost his life. His death was not in vain however, as he and his people had forced the Rakata off Korriban. Taking what remained of their enemies' spacecraft, the previously primitive Sith&mdash;now instantly propelled into a space age and armed with mastery of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], both acquired from the Rakata&mdash;went on to conquer other nearby worlds, in what would later come to be known as Sith Space.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force" /> Foremost among these worlds were [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="TWW" /> [[Malachor V]],<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="BOS" /> [[Tund/Legends|Tund]],<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="BOS" /><ref name="TWW" /> [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]],<ref name="TWW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> [[Thule/Legends|Thule]], and [[Arorua]],<ref name="BOS" /> with their capital being relocated from Korriban to the neighboring Ziost.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force" /> Peace in the Empire was short-lived, dissolving into a [[Korriban civil war|civil war]] due to the power vacuum caused by the death of Adas, with many different leaders claiming the title of Sith'ari.<ref name="END" />

At some point prior to the creation of [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] before 16,899 BBY,<ref name="War date" /> the Sith Empire became embroiled in a [[Unidentified war (Sith Empire)|war]] during which the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] pressed into military service for the first [[Time/Legends|time]] various varieties of warbeast, including the [[Silooth/Legends|silooth]], the [[Sith warbird]] and the [[Sith war behemoth]], in order to aid their campaign. During one major engagement of the war, the [[Battle of Kalsunor]], hordes of mutated silooths were released by the Sith on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalsunor]], and the creatures proceeded to ravish the world.<ref name="BOS" />

Around [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the Sith Empire backed uprisings in the distant areas of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Republic Fleet Systems]] was founded to create [[Republic Fleet Systems warship|warships]] meant to counter the threat.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

In [[14,000 BBY]], the Sith Empire abandoned a [[library-temple]] that they established on [[Krayiss II]].<ref name="ATDS">{{WEGCite|story=A Tale from the Dark Side|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref>

In [[7000 BBY]], the Sith Empire established a library called [[Veeshas Tuwan]] on [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]].<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

In 7000 BBY, [[Sith sorcerer]] [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]] [[Graush dynasty|rose to power]] through a [[Korriban civil war (Dathka Graush)|brutal campaign]] in which he overtook two-thirds of Korriban. Graush was eventually assassinated by his own followers, deemed too insane and bloodthirsty to rule by a species famous for its brutality. However, relics of his rule remained to be studied by [[Sorzus Syn]] and the [[Exiles]] when they arrived on Korriban about fifty years after Graush died in c. [[6950 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point before the year [[6900 BBY]], [[Hakagram Graush]] was made King of the Sith. However, Graush's reign was short-lived. Following the [[Battle of Corbos]], a group of fallen Jedi [[Exiles]] [[Discovery of Korriban|arrived]] on Korriban thanks to Sorzus Syn's pursuit of the fabled<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> Kingdom of the Sith,<ref name="BMF82">{{BuildFalconCite|82|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] soon seized power by assassinating the king and impressing the Sith people with their mastery of the Force. They would go on to found the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]] and [[Sith Empire/Legends|their own empire]].<ref name="BOS" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Tales of the Jedi Companion]], [[Ood Bnar]] says that the Sith "were not united, preferring to remain in tribal 'circles,'" when [[Ajunta Pall]] conquered them, but Ood Bnar lived in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="TOJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> 2900 years after Ajunta Pall,<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force" /> while [[Sorzus Syn]] witnessed Ajunta Pall meeting and beheading [[Hakagram Graush]]<ref name="BOS" />, so this article assumes that Bnar was misinformed.

When the [[canon]] was that the Exiles' Sith Empire was created ~[[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]],''<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>'' it was assumed that the Exiles' Sith Empire was responsible for Sith activity before 6900 BBY such as the "Sith-backed uprisings" that led to [[Republic Fleet Systems]] being founded ~[[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]],<ref name="EGVV" /> the Sith spirits that had been in the library-temple on Krayiss II since 14,000 BBY,<ref name="ATDS" /> Dathka Graush reigning in 7000 BBY,<ref name="POLS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031002korriban1|series=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls|text=Part 1: Haunted Hideout}}</ref> and the Sith Library of [[Veeshas Tuwan]] being established in 7000 BBY,<ref name="EGAS" /> but when the creation of the Exiles' Sith Empire was [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] to have happened in [[6900 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the implication became that Adas's Sith Empire was responsible for all Sith activity prior to 6900 BBY.
